full_name: Cheryl D. Knott | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Biological Sciences Radcliffe Fellow Boston University
bio: Cheryl D. Knott is a biological anthropologist and the director of a long-running orangutan research and conservation program whose research integrates primate behavioral ecology and physiology to understand how energetics shapes reproduction and life history in humans and other apes.
